text:
Eli F.: Hi team, Eli here. Starting on-call next Monday — quick checklist?
Rina M.: Welcome Eli! Must-haves: PagerDuty account, Okta group add, Confluence read for runbooks, SSH keys, repo access for staging runner.
Eli F.: PagerDuty invite pending. I submitted Okta request but reviewer field was unclear.
Devexbot: auto: Submit Okta request to add group 'redwood-oncall-new-hires'. Reviewer: @Samir K.. Link: https://okta.example.com/app/requests/new
Samir K.: I'll approve once it's filed. Also add your phone under PD Profile -> Contact Methods for call escalation. If phone option missing, request 'pager-call-access'.
Eli F.: How do I practice incidents? Want to do a 30m mock before my first solo.
Rina M.: Use infra/playbooks/mock-incidents runner: `python tools/mock_incident_runner.py --scenario latency --duration 30`. Need git + staging-aws role.
Eli F.: I don't have git access yet.
Devexbot: auto: Open git access request at https://git.example.com/access-requests. Tag with 'oncall-practice'.
Samir K.: We'll mark your first two shifts as mentor-assisted so alerts route to you and your mentor. Rina will shadow the first night.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete async module 'Oncall 101' before your first shadow. Link: https://learn.redwood/oncall-101
Eli F.: Thanks all  last one: timezone swap etiquette? My teammate is CET.
Rina M.: Use PagerDuty override -> Request Override, set timezone, then post swap link in #eng-oncall. For urgent swaps <6h DM a lead.
Eli F.: Great — filing forms now. Appreciate the fast approvals!
